What’s Covered

On-Site Labor Covers technician diagnostic and repair visits during the covered warranty period.
Replacement Parts Covers covered parts needed to restore machine function, including applicable moving parts, electronics, belts, bearings, motors, cables, pulleys, and related components.
Wear Components Covers covered wearable parts such as heart-rate monitors, pedals, tread belts, running belts, tracks, cables, and decks when failure prevents normal machine function.

How Service Works

Service Is Coordinated by Fitness Superstore Northern California service may be handled by our own technicians. Other service areas may be handled through our technician network.
Technician Dispatch Timing A technician is typically dispatched after diagnosis and coverage confirmation. Timing may vary by location, technician availability, and parts availability.
Non-Transferable Warranty coverage applies to the original purchaser and is not transferable.
Cosmetic Issues Cosmetic damage or delivery-related cosmetic issues must be reported quickly after delivery. Cosmetic issues reported later may not be covered.
Residential or Commercial Use
Residential For equipment used in a home by the original purchaser and household.
Commercial For equipment used by a business or in a commercial environment, including gyms, hotels, apartment communities, schools, military facilities, studios, or similar settings.
Service and Delivery Regions

International shipping is available under the standard international door-to-port (CIF) terms shown on the website. Contact us before ordering only if you need different shipping terms or special handling.

SCIFIT Treadmills are high performance machines with certain power requirements that must be maintained in the field for proper operation. Inadequate power may result in intermittent failure of the elevation system and improper speed valuation of the running belt.

"Dedicated circuits" for each treadmill must be installed in accordance with current voltage drop standards set by NEC code. See Table 1 below. (Table 1 shall be considered as a guideline only; any questions should be brought to the attention of a licensed electrician.)

Note: A dedicated circuit is a power outlet reserved for the exclusive use of one and only one treadmill. This includes hot, neutral, and ground wires. This is done to provide proper frame ground drainage of the treadmill. The outlet should not be shared with any other piece of equipment.


Table 1

Source Voltage Maximum Distance from Source Minimum Cable Size
240V 121 feet / 36.3 meters 12 AWG
240V 193 feet / 57.9 meters 10 AWG
240V 307 feet / 92.1 meters 8 AWG
240V 488 feet / 146.4 meters 6 AWG

Calculations based on NEC code table 310-16 with 3% Voltage drop on a copper conductor 240V service.

What does the remanufacturing process consist of?

Our remanufactured equipment was all pre-owned, nearly all of it from commercial facilities throughout the country. Equipment is generally obtained through club trade ins, or when off leases.

At Fitness Superstore, we have the most rigorous remanufacturing process in the industry. All machines are disassembled, sanded, and repainted. Parts like the belts, bearings, and batteries are replaced on every machine. All other parts that are worn more than 25% are replaced. We guarantee (Covered by our Warranty) your machine to be in “like new” working and “close to new” cosmetic condition. Click Play on the video for thorough details.

Our 7 Stage Process

Stage 1: Initial Inspection

Heart Rate Monitor (Connection, Accuracy Display)

Display Console (Programs, Buttons, LED’s)

Special Features (Resistance, Speed, Incline)

Every machine is carefully inspected, tested, and diagnosed by our talented team of technicians.

Stage 2: Noise Review

Our technicians inspect the motion of the machine for unusual noises. Any system flaws discovered are repaired and/or replaced with new parts.

Stage 3: Disassembly

Each machine is fully disassembled, thoroughly cleaned, and inspected by our technicians.

Stage 4: Parts Replacement

Mechanical parts worn more than 25% are placed.

Drive belts are replaced on all units.

Walking belts are replaced on all treadmills (excluding Woodways).

All hardware, chains, pulleys, cables, and wheels are inspected and replaced as needed

Batteries are replaced on all units.

Stage 5: Re-Assembly

The machine is then re-assembled to match factory specifications and begins to be restored to a “like new” cosmetic condition.

Stage 6: Exterior Restoration

Machines are sandblasted to original steel for heavy wear or sanded by hand for light scratches.

Machines are repainted with the latest technology to eliminate imperfections and prevent discoloration. Custom colors are also available.

All hardware, chains, pulleys, cables, and wheels are inspected and replaced as needed.

All worn plastic, vinyl, rubber, foam, and end caps are replaced.

Power cords are inspected for wear and replaced if necessary.

Lubricants and waxes are applied to ensure optimum function and longevity.

Stage 7: Final Inspection

In the last stage of the remanufacturing process, our technicians re-inspect every machine and re-test every element to guarantee quality.

To use the slides with the Model D rower, you need 11 feet of space. You need a pair of slides to do so.

Add an on water feel to your Model A, B, C, D or E Indoor Rower with the Concept2 Slide!

If you already have a pair of Concept2 Slides and want to be able to link two or more indoor rowers together to simulate a "double" for great team training, you can purchase a spare slide (one slide, as pictured).
How many slides do you need?
When linking indoor rowers together, you always need one more slide than the number of indoor rowers you are linking. For example, if you want to link four indoor rowers together, you need five individual slides. So, you would need to purchase two pairs of slides and one single slide to achieve the five slides needed.

If you just want to put one indoor rower on slides, order a pairs of slides instead.
Sliding Single
Set up as a sliding single, the indoor rower moves back and forth under you, more like rowing on the water. You get a quicker catch and can row at a higher stroke rate, because you aren’t moving your body mass—you are only moving the mass of the indoor rower.
Team Boat Slide
Connect Models C, D and/or E Indoor Rowers to create a team boat slide. A great training tool for coaches, creating a team boat slide makes your crew work together.
Technical Details
  • Construction: Each slide consists of a base with two tracks and a wheeled carriage that runs on the tracks. Light bungee cord tension keeps the carriage centered on the base
  • Number needed: Slides are sold in pairs and spares. You’ll need two slides (a pair), to “float” one indoor rower: one slide each for the front and back legs. To create a team boat slide, you’ll need a pair plus a spare for each additional indoor rower you plan to connect. For example, to connect two indoor rowers, you’ll need three slides: a pair and a spare. To connect three indoor rowers, you’ll need four slides: two pairs.
  • Space needed
    • Sliding single (one indoor rower on a pair of slides)—11 ft x 4 ft (335 cm x 122 cm)
    • Team boats
      • Length required = (number of indoor rowers x 8.5 feet) + 3.5 feet
      • Length required = (number of indoor rowers x 259 cm ) + 107 cm
  • Level floor surface recommended
  • Compatibility
    • Sliding single—Models A, B, C, D or E Indoor Rowers
    • Team boat—Models C, D or E Indoor Rowers

Virtual Active Guided workouts include helpful instructions from a professional trainer, while the Basic workouts allow you to set your own pace and enjoy the scenery.

To be able to ride clipless pedals, you need special shoes to which the counterparts to the pedals – namely, the cleats – can be firmly screwed.

11 Reasons to use SPD Pedals


  • SPD pedals keep your feet in place making it easier to pedal at a good cadence (the speed you pedal measured in revolutions of one pedal per minute; a good goal is 70 to 90rpm).
  • They optimize the connection between foot and pedal so more of your energy makes its way into every pedal stroke, which is great for climbing, accelerating and long rides.
  • Most modern systems provide some degree of float allowing your feet to self align on the pedals. This feature is like a buffer that helps prevent knee problems.
  • They help when you're trying to hop the bike to clear obstacles, such as curbs, logs and rocks.
  • They won't snag on roots, sticks and debris the way toe clips and straps can when you're riding on the bottoms of the pedals or walking your bike down the trail.
  • They're easier to get into than toe clips and straps.
  • With a little practice, they're safer to get out of than toe clips and straps because the release motion is simpler and more natural.
  • They're comfortable to pedal on when you get shoes that fit your feet and the pedals.
  • There's no cage to chafe your foot or cut into your shoe and no strap to restrict circulation.
  • They're lighter than regular pedals and pedals with clips and straps.
  • They look minimal, sleek and cool.

French Fitness OWA14 Olympic Weight Adapter Sleeve 14"

The French Fitness OWA14 Olympic Weight Adapter Sleeve is designed to convert 1" standard-sized weight bars and equipment into 2" Olympic-sized compatible ones. By converting standard bars into Olympic-sized ones, these sleeves allow lifters to use Olympic weight plates on non-Olympic equipment. This adaptability opens up a wider range of exercise, enhancing the overall effectiveness and diversity of strength training routines. Whether it's a standard barbell, dumbbell handles, or cable machines, these sleeves can be easily attached, transforming them into Olympic-sized equipment. This versatility makes the French Fitness OWA14 Olympic Weight Adapter Sleeve a cost-effective solution for individuals who already own standard-sized equipment but wish to incorporate Olympic plates into their workouts.

Lightweight and portable, these Olympic Weight Adapter Sleeves can conveniently fit into a gym bag or occupy minimal space when stored, allowing users to bring their preferred equipment wherever they go. Smoothly glides over the bar, providing a secure fit for Olympic plates. Features a metal hex bolt lock-down to provide additional stability and ensure that the sleeve remains fixed in place on the barbell. This helps maintain proper alignment and prevents the sleeve from slipping or coming loose. Also comes with end caps to prevent the sleeve from sliding off the barbell during use. The caps create a barrier at each end of the sleeve, ensuring a secure fit and reducing the risk of the sleeve becoming loose or dislodged during weightlifting exercises. Additionally, end caps can help protect the barbell from potential damage or wear caused by repeated contact with the sleeve. They act as a cushioning layer that absorbs impact and minimizes friction between the sleeve and the barbell, prolonging the lifespan of both the sleeve and the barbell.

Smoothly glides over the bar, providing a secure fit for Olympic plates. Features a metal hex bolt lock-down to provide additional stability and ensure that the sleeve remains fixed in place on the barbell. This helps maintain proper alignment and prevents the sleeve from slipping or coming loose. Also comes with end caps to prevent the sleeve from sliding off the barbell during use. The caps create a barrier at each end of the sleeve, ensuring a secure fit and reducing the risk of the sleeve becoming loose or dislodged during weightlifting exercises. Additionally, end caps can help protect the barbell from potential damage or wear caused by repeated contact with the sleeve. They act as a cushioning layer that absorbs impact and minimizes friction between the sleeve and the barbell, prolonging the lifespan of both the sleeve and the barbell.

Flooring Installation Options

No Thanks – Curbside Delivery Only

Your artificial grass turf are placed on the closest curb to your location accessible by a 24 foot box truck. If you don't have a curb it will be the end of the driveway / part of your property closest to the street. It is a 1 person delivery, and it will arrive in a crate. The truck will back up, use a liftgate, and drop the pallet off. The customer will be responsible for placing the machine where they want it, as well as removing / disposing of packaging. Some products will arrive disassembled, and some fully assembled. See the product page for more info, or contact us if you need any clarification on whether or not this method will apply to your situation. Shipping transportation time is 2-14 Business Days if you’re in the lower 48 states, and longer outside.

Includes Cutting as needed; No Gluing ($199 + $200/pc)

Your artificial grass turf will be cut as needed to fit your space, including adjustments for edges, corners, and layout requirements. This ensures proper sizing and a cleaner overall look upon installation.

No gluing or adhesive application is included with this option. The turf will be delivered ready for placement, but the customer will be responsible for securing it in place, completing any final adjustments, and handling installation steps such as seaming or anchoring if needed.

This option is best if you prefer a DIY installation or plan to use your own installer.

Includes Gluing and Cutting as needed ($399 + $300/pc)

Your artificial grass turf will be fully cut and professionally installed with adhesive as needed to ensure a secure, seamless, and long-lasting finish. This includes fitting the turf to your space, handling edges and corners, and applying glue for proper bonding.

This option provides a more complete installation solution, ideal if you want a cleaner, more permanent setup without handling the technical work yourself. The result is a more stable surface with reduced shifting or lifting over time.

The customer should ensure the installation area is clear and ready prior to service. Minor site preparation (such as leveling or base work) may not be included unless specified.
